chunks: And al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from 'Abd al-'Aziz al-'Abdi, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
It is not appropriate for anyone to enter the grave wearing two sandals, nor two leather socks, nor a cloak, nor a cap.

key_terms.الْقَبْرَ: the grave; the burial space being entered during funeral rites
key_terms.خُفَّيْنِ: two leather socks or khuffs; another form of footwear mentioned
key_terms.رِدَاءٍ: a cloak or outer garment worn over the body
key_terms.نَعْلَيْنِ: two sandals; footwear prohibited here when entering the grave

ai.seo_question: What should a person avoid wearing when entering the grave for burial rites?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an etiquette-based legal instruction regarding entering the grave during burial. It indicates that one who enters the grave should not do so while wearing sandals, leather socks, a cloak, or a cap.
